workLog.action: Wire scripts/validate_workflows.py into the pr-validation validate-pr job and add tests/ci/test_ci_scripts_are_wired.py
workLog.result: Workflow YAML was checked only by lefthook, so it landed unvalidated from Renovate, Dependabot, the web editor, the API, and any clone without hooks installed. No workflow triggers on .github/workflows/**, and pytest.yml gates on python-changed, so a workflow-only PR passed through every gate untouched. The validate-pr job is the right host because it runs on every PR regardless of path. actionlint stays out on purpose: it is not in the runner image, so adding it is a download-and-trust decision worth making on its own. The wiring test is the more durable half. Issue #3329 was two guards with green tests and no caller, which unit tests cannot catch because the missing thing is the call site. The new test parametrizes over every scripts/ci/*.py and asserts a workflow references it, with a documented allowlist so an exemption is a decision rather than a silent skip. Negative controls: an unwired probe script fails only its own parametrized case; deleting the new workflow step fails only the named validator test.

learnings: A guard with passing tests and no call site is not half-finished, it is unverified: its tests exercise the interface while the scope, which is where #3329's ratchet was wrong by a factor of two, goes unexercised until something actually runs it.
nextSteps: Decide separately whether to add actionlint to CI, which requires a pinned download step.
